record.question: In paramagnetic materials
options: permanent magnetic dipoles exist but the interaction between neighbouring dipoles is negligible
permanent magnetic dipole do not exist
permanent magnetic dipoles exist and the interaction between neighbouring dipoles is very strong
permanent magnetic dipole moment may or may not exist
record.explanation: In paramagnetic materials the atomic permanent dipoles exist but neighbouring dipole interactions are negligible, so they align only under an applied field.
